mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.6% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 3.6%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a decline in the inflation rate signals a potential easing of monetary policy, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units over the past month signals weak residential construction, which indicates a broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1400), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 20000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 20000) signals strong economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 20000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
